results.item_about: Overview This feature service provides boundary polygons for Tennessee state parks. It supports display, reference, and analysis of park extents across the state of Tennessee. Feature Layers State Park Boundaries A polygon layer representing the primary named boundaries of Tennessee state parks. The layer includes a park identifier, the park name, and supporting geometry fields used for spatial analysis and cartographic display.
